verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at quo.com (HTTP 200) describing the product. The Mintlify-hosted API docs also provide their own llms.txt and .md mirrors of every page, plus a 'Build with AI LLMs' guide, so an agent has machine-readable docs to read. Missing for 10: no hands-on probe of the docs-level llms.txt or the .md mirrors (the root docs.md returned 404), and no independent corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
